name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
label: Quest
description: Ursius of the Shardtooth: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In the snowy mountains of Winterspring, to the northwest, a skilled hunter stalks his prey... I speak of Ursius of the shardtooth bears, an agile and clever beast.
I send you now against him. He roams the sloping hills to the northwest of Everlook. Find and hunt him, before he discovers your intent.
All that have gone up against Ursius have quickly found themselves to be the prey, and he, the hunter. Stay on your guard.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Go now, adventurer. Seek out Ursius.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This was no easy task, yet you have excelled. But do not be too quick to think you have impressed me, friend.
